cases.task: Choose how a dashboard should update its durable resume cursor when an SSE event has a valid accepted lastEventId but its JSON payload is malformed and cannot be rendered.

required_facts.text: EventSource accepts and stores the SSE id independently from application JSON parsing.
Leaving the dashboard cursor behind after an accepted frame makes a later manual reconnect replay that frame.
The malformed payload should be visibly labeled without discarding the accepted durable cursor.
